title: 8 common NV2A blend (sfactor, dfactor, equation) combinations
purpose: Render an 8-cell 4x2 grid where each cell exercises one of the most-common NV2A blend tuples. Per cell: blend-disabled DST draw paints the cell to DST_COLOR; blend-enabled SRC draw with (sfactor, dfactor, equation) draws SRC_COLOR over it. Math-derived expected output lands on saturated 0/255 cube corners (RED/GREEN/YELLOW/CYAN/MAGENTA/BLUE), so byte-exact across renderers regardless of display gamma. Tuples covered: (1) ONE/ZERO/ADD overwrite (sfactor mapping check); (2) ZERO/ONE/ADD DST-only (dfactor mapping check); (3) ONE/ONE/ADD additive (saturating-add semantics); (4) ONE/ONE/REVERSE_SUBTRACT (DST-SRC clamp); (5) ONE/ONE/SUBTRACT (SRC-DST clamp); (6) SRC_ALPHA/ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA/ADD at alpha=255 (collapses to overwrite via alpha=1; verifies SRC_ALPHA factor mapping); (7) DST_COLOR/ZERO/ADD modulate; (8) ZERO/SRC_COLOR/ADD modulate. v0.1 deliberately uses only alpha=255/0 endpoints to keep all results byte-exact -- mid-range alpha and constant-color factors are second-wave follow-ups. The §4.9 spec describes 128 cells (16 sfactors x 8 dfactor/equation rows); v0.1 narrows to 8 to match the rest of the first-wave 4x2 grid convention while covering the dominant blend modes used by Xbox titles.
